title: Seadra's Whirlpool Can Swallow Fishing Boats

direction.premise: Seadra spins whirlpools strong enough to swallow fishing boats, then uses those currents to weaken prey.
direction.audiencePromise: See how Seadra turns one boat-swallowing whirlpool into a hunting weapon.
direction.openLoop: How does Seadra turn a whirlpool into a hunting move?
direction.payoff: Seadra uses those currents to weaken prey, then swallows it whole.
direction.engagementQuestion: More frightening: boat-swallowing whirlpools or oversized-food suction?

voice.instructions: Speak like a knowledgeable fan telling a friend something shocking. Keep the pace quick, warm, and playful. Stress boat-swallowing, weakened prey, and oversized-food suction. Pause briefly before the final either-or question.

scenes.headline: BOATS CAN DISAPPEAR
scenes.narration: Seadra's whirlpool can swallow fishing boats.
scenes.caption: A WHIRLPOOL THAT SWALLOWS BOATS

scenes.headline: SEADRA SPINS THE WATER
scenes.narration: It spins its body, generating whirlpools from that motion.
scenes.caption: BODY SPIN → WHIRLPOOL

scenes.headline: THE CURRENT WEAKENS PREY
scenes.narration: The surprising part is what happens next: those currents weaken prey.
scenes.caption: CURRENTS WEAKEN PREY

scenes.headline: THE WHIRLPOOL STARTS THE HUNT
scenes.narration: The currents weaken prey. Then Seadra swallows it whole.
scenes.caption: WEAKENED PREY. FINAL SWALLOW.

scenes.headline: A SLENDER MOUTH. HUGE SUCTION.
scenes.narration: Its mouth is slender, but suction takes in food larger than the opening.
scenes.caption: SUCTION BEATS THE MOUTH'S SIZE

scenes.headline: WHICH IS WORSE?
scenes.narration: More frightening: boat-swallowing whirlpools or oversized-food suction?
scenes.caption: WHIRLPOOL OR SUCTION?
